blurb: Wendella offers a variety of boat tours and cruises on the Chicago River and Lake Michigan. Guests can enjoy guided architecture tours, sunset cruises, wine and cheese cruises, and fireworks cruises. The company operates year-round with climate-controlled vessels and experienced guides.

quotes.text: The BEST tour guides on the Chicago River! I've been on the Wendella boats for the Chicago River Architecture Tour several times and it's been fantastic every time and worth every penny!
I've done the Wendella Boat Tour four times now whenever friends or family visit, and it's always an awesome experience. This is a must-do if you're in Chicago.
The Wendella architecture tour came highly recommended to us when we moved to Chicago. I will say the hype is real.
The tour and guide were fantastic. Everything was clear and engaging, we didn't even notice the time flying by
I loved the tour guide; she was funny while still being educational. Would highly recommend
We learned alot and enjoyed the beauty of downtown from the water.
